richiami.difetto: It is possible for a crack to form around the fuel outlet to tank joint. This could lead to a fuel leak and in the worst case fire.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the fuel tank and fuel tap.

richiami.difetto: The frame may crack adjacent to the rear footrests which if not rectified in the worst case will lead to the frame collapsing and loss of control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to identify the frame and where necessary replace the frame with one of a modified design.
